summary: The design separates process truth from model narration: ownership, liveness, verdicts and evidence are enforced by the host even when the acting model is uncertain or unavailable.

points.text: Safety requires both halves of claiming: a renewable lease makes abandonment observable, while a fencing token checked at every protected side effect prevents a stale runner from acting after reassignment.

The verdict taxonomy is intentionally process-facing. Blocked and needs-input preserve a valid task that cannot presently advance; infra-failure prevents broken credentials, runners or sensors from being mislabeled as product failure or success.
Human participation is a normal actor transition. An escalation packet must name the decision, relevant evidence, attempted paths, remaining authority and the consequence of each option.
A compact hand-off is not a lossy summary when durable process evidence remains addressable. It is a least-context view over an immutable path, tailored to the next actor's responsibility.
